title: Personal color analysis quiz: what season am I? Free test — cv.cm
description: Free seasonal color analysis quiz: answer 14 questions about your veins, skin, hair and eyes to find out if you're a spring, summer, autumn or winter, with your best colors, neutrals and metals. No photo, no sign-up.
h1: Personal color analysis: what season am I?
lede: Do gold or silver earrings suit you better, and does black make you look sharp or tired? Answer 14 quick questions to find your color season and the shades that make your face glow.
about: Seasonal color analysis sorts people by two things: undertone, the warm (golden, peachy) or cool (pink, bluish) cast under your skin, and depth, how light or dark your natural coloring is overall. Warm and light is spring, cool and light is summer, warm and deep is autumn, cool and deep is winter. The idea grew out of the color theory of Bauhaus teacher Johannes Itten and was popularized in the 1980s by Carole Jackson's book Color Me Beautiful; today many analysts split each season into three for twelve, or more, sub-seasons.

This quiz uses the simple four-season version. Seven questions ask about undertone and seven about depth, and your result shows where you landed on both. For the most reliable answers, look in a mirror in daylight without makeup, and think of your natural hair color. A self-check can't replace a professional draping session, so treat your season as a starting point and trust what you see in the mirror.

faq.q: How do I know if my undertone is warm or cool?
faq.a: Look at the veins on your inner wrist in daylight: greenish veins usually mean warm, blue or purple veins cool. Gold jewelry tends to flatter warm undertones and silver cool ones, and people who tan easily often lean warm while those who burn and turn pink lean cool.

faq.q: What are the four color seasons?
faq.a: Spring is warm and light (peach, coral, warm aqua), summer is cool and light (powder blue, lavender, rose), autumn is warm and deep (rust, olive, mustard) and winter is cool and deep (black, pure white, royal blue, true red).

Many people are. If one of your scores is close to the middle, you may be a neutral or a soft season; try colors from both neighboring seasons and keep the ones that make your skin look clear and even.

faq.q: Do I need to upload a photo?
faq.a: No. The quiz only asks questions, and your answers stay in your browser.

spring.name: Spring: warm and light
spring.body: You have a warm, golden glow and light, fresh coloring. Clear, warm colors make you look bright: peach, coral, warm pink, golden yellow, apple green, turquoise and warm aqua. For neutrals pick camel, ivory, light warm grey and navy rather than black, and choose gold over silver. Very dark, dusty or icy shades can make you look tired.

summer.name: Summer: cool and light
summer.body: You have a cool, rosy undertone and soft, light coloring. Gentle cool colors flatter you: powder blue, lavender, rose pink, soft raspberry, sea green and periwinkle. For neutrals pick soft white, dove grey, cool taupe and blue-grey instead of harsh black, and wear silver, white gold or rose gold. Bright orange and heavy earthy browns can overpower you.

autumn.name: Autumn: warm and deep
autumn.body: You have a warm undertone and rich, deep coloring. Earthy, golden colors make you glow: rust, terracotta, olive, mustard, forest green, burnt orange and teal. For neutrals pick chocolate brown, camel, khaki and cream instead of stark white and grey, and wear gold, bronze or copper. Icy pastels and cool neon shades can look flat on you.

winter.name: Winter: cool and deep
winter.body: You have a cool undertone and strong, deep coloring, often with high contrast. Clear, vivid and icy colors suit you: true red, royal blue, emerald, fuchsia, black, pure white and icy pink or blue. For neutrals pick black, charcoal, navy and crisp white, and choose silver or platinum. Muted earth tones such as mustard, rust and beige can make you look washed out.
